answer: Model attestations as a grove of directed edges rooted in 12 independently audited agents. Each root lends at most 10 credits per epoch. Max-flow from those roots caps payout; a thousand meadow aliases behind one ingress edge still share its five-credit limit. To lift that cap, each new fake needs another independent root endorsement backed by a 100-token vault bond for 30 days. Signed edge updates and public max-flow proofs enforce budgets, so even at the zenith of demand, internal sybil edges cannot create credit.
